artifacts.summary: Third-pass single-question report closing report 02's open item E2 in the affirmative at D = Z: FwdRec forces every total history to be periodic, so FwdRec is the exact correspondent for the FULL density schema over Z; refutes the dispatch's lead (the full 2-shift is a legal frame, so the digraph reduction is faithful and limit is not the mechanism, but that frame fails FwdRec on the one-off walk); records a paper counterexample showing the periodicity conclusion is false over a general non-dense D, and opens E2-prime

Machine-checked Lean evidence for report 03: 646 lines, compiles under lake env lean with exit 0, no errors, no sorry, all headline results checked with #print axioms; contains freeFrame, freeFrame_bool_not_fwdRec, the walk theory (succ_unique, periodic), truthAt_add_hist_period, density_of_hist_periodic, and Bridge.density_schema_iff_fwdRec

key_findings: E2 is TRUE at D = Z and proved: FwdRec F implies every total history of F is periodic (Bridge.hist_periodic), via the pure digraph theorem Walk.periodic

The load-bearing step is determinism, not finiteness: AllRec forces the one-step relation to have no state with two distinct walk-successors (Walk.succ_unique), by a minimal-closed-walk splicing argument that explains all of report 02's failed candidate digraphs at once
Full-schema exactness over Z is proved: F validates every instance of GG-phi to G-phi, phi ranging over all formulas, iff FwdRec F (Bridge.density_schema_iff_fwdRec)

The dispatch's lead is refuted: the full 2-shift IS a legal task frame (freeFrame Bool), so report 02 section 2's digraph reduction is faithful and limit is not the hidden ingredient - over a D with a least positive element limit is vacuous. The lead's walk is not a counterexample because FwdRec quantifies over ALL histories and the same frame admits a one-off visit

Report 02 section 9's Phase E1 is unnecessary and should be deleted: Truth.box_time_const (already in the tree) discharges the box case of a per-history periodicity induction, so no Formula.BoxFree predicate is needed and truthAt_add_hist_period holds for every formula over arbitrary D
Phase B's flagged import-direction question disappears: the new Phase B-prime needs only Semantics/Truth.lean, not Metalogic/Independence/LoopingDuration

CAVEAT (paper): the periodicity conclusion is FALSE over a general non-dense D - the frame with carrier the disjoint union of Z/nZ over D = Z lex-times Z is FwdRec but has a total history with no period; the density consequence appears to survive there by an order-automorphism argument, unproved
open_items: E2-prime (open, new): over an arbitrary non-dense D, is FwdRec still equivalent to full-schema density, with 'periodic' weakened to 'shift-recurrent under an order-automorphism of (D,<) preserving tau'? Report 03 section 4.1 sketches the route for one frame only.

The Z lex Z counterexample of report 03 section 4 is paper-only (~150 lines to formalise). Nothing in report 03 sections 1-3 depends on it; it functions only as a scope limit on the D = Z exactness claim.
